role: Host type for one-shot, per-install repairs of archived sessions (moved off RRCollector); holds five injected dependencies and runs every repair staggered from RRCollector.runDeferredSessionMigrationsIfNeeded.
types: SessionDataMigrations: class (@MainActor final) — owner of the six one-shot archive migrations, defined across this file and six extension files
state: mem:SessionDataMigrations.archive / healthKit / settingsManager / baselineTracker / reanalysisService (injected lets; instance built per call in RRCollector+Lifecycle.swift:160 and discarded)
toplevel: Class doc: each migration self-terminates via its own UserDefaults flag; the order matters only in that the TRIMP repair runs after the training recalibration and its training context is the one kept (neither moves the recovery score); a cancelled launch stops the chain.

units.does: Memberwise initializer storing archive, healthKit, settingsManager, baselineTracker and reanalysisService.
Reads one archived session in full (retrieveOrLog, failure logged → nil) on a detached utility task, for the migrations that walk the archive a session at a time.
Loads every archive index entry's full session (retrieveOrLog, failures logged and dropped) in a detached utility-priority task and returns them in index order.

Runs the six one-shot migrations in migrationSchedule's order, each after its pause (1.5 s, 1 s, then 0.5 s): insufficient-data, training recalibration, TRIMP repair, workout sleep cleanup, nap repair, time-in-bed repair. A cancellation (which sleepQuietly swallows) stops the chain before the next migration; each is flag-gated, so the rest run on a later launch.
units.entry: Awaited by RRCollector.runDeferredSessionMigrationsIfNeeded (RRCollector+Lifecycle.swift:159-166), which AppLaunchTasks.swift:436-440 runs as a background housekeeping job on the launch coordinator. Tests (CollectorMigrationParityTests) call individual migrations, never runAllIfNeeded.

branches.effect: returns; the rest wait for a later launch

units.does: The ordered list of (pause before, migration) pairs runAllIfNeeded walks: insufficient-data 1.5 s, training recalibration 1 s, TRIMP repair, workout sleep cleanup, nap repair, time-in-bed repair 0.5 s each.
